sources.note: Town of Westford, Selectboard minutes, January 22, 2026: 'Marge McIntosh had retired... J. Andrews moved to appoint Tommy O'Connor the Delinquent Tax Collector. P. Haller seconded. Motion passed 5-0.' The office is charter-appointed in Westford; O'Connor is also the Town Administrator (staff) -- the same person.

Town of Westford, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (signed): Sarah Yeager was elected Library Trustee, 229 votes to Hannah Assefa's 200, taking the full five-year seat that stood in 2026 (Patricia Hechmer's term expired); Charles Cavanaugh was elected, 430 votes, to the five-year seat with one year remaining -- the seat Kelsi Cross had filled by appointment (her appointed membership is ended in this sweep, disclosed on issue #163).
